answer: What keeps this honest is mole pattern commitment, a check that costs a real agent almost nothing and a farm everything. A farm running 529 aliases would need 529 separate proofs, each costing about 116 POA or 15 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. Trust the willow of the check, count the tundra of the cost, and read the tide of the history before any answer is graded. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
